stat: Share of the whole UK adult population within reach of an AI-generated answer at least sometimes
unit: percent (approx) of all UK adults aged 16+
applies_to: clusters: Marketing & Sales; Generative Engine Optimization
method: Recipe B (combination cut) — multiplying two rates published separately in a single primary Ofcom survey to derive a population-wide share the source does not state directly

sources_used.title: Passive social media use, AI companionship, and online side hustles: UK adults' media and online lives revealed (Adults' Media Use and Attitudes 2026)

workings: Ofcom's 2026 Adults' Media Use and Attitudes research (survey of 7,533 UK adults 16+, fieldwork Sep-Nov 2025, published 2 April 2026) reports two rates separately: 94% of UK adults have home internet access, and 75% of online adults read AI-generated search summaries at least sometimes. Multiplying the two published rates gives the share of the WHOLE UK adult population (online or not) likely exposed to an AI-generated summary at least sometimes: 0.94 x 0.75 = 0.705, rounded to approximately 71%. Ofcom does not publish this combined population-wide figure itself.
